## Why I Stopped

The standing objective is partly advanced, not complete. The verified topological and theta consequences are committed; the remaining frontier requires genuine analytic/holomorphic infrastructure and approved source linkage. `fs-mumford` remains `running`.

## Next

Build the coordinate-free complex-vector quotient manifold bridge, or formalize the missing complex-Lie exponential substrate. On the theta side, use the new restriction-surjectivity theorem to discharge existing maximal-isotropic quotient and square-cardinality hypotheses.
